description: This file contains shell functions for upgrading firmware on eMMC storage in OpenWrt. It includes functions for handling tar and fit images, copying configurations, and performing upgrade steps specific to eMMC devices.

methods.name: emmc_upgrade_tar
methods.description: Upgrades eMMC with a tar image, extracting kernel and root filesystem, and writing to device blocks.

methods.name: emmc_upgrade_fit
methods.description: Upgrades eMMC with a fit image, extracting kernel image, and writing to device blocks.

methods.name: emmc_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data to eMMC devices.

methods.name: emmc_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main entry point for upgrading eMMC; determines image type and calls appropriate function.
